exteriorColors: In Brisbane, two Kia cars were damaged by Kia Challenge participants in failed attempts to steal the vehicles.[13] This is despite the vulnerability not existing in Australian cars manufactured since 2001.[14]

Trim: On October 23, 2022, six teenagers aged 14 to 19 stole a Kia Sportage in Buffalo, New York. Four of the teenagers were killed when they subsequently crashed the stolen car. The Buffalo Police Department linked the incident to the Kia Challenge.[20]
